features.name: bmi_obesity_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for obesity, defined as a Body Mass Index (mass) of 30 or greater.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a clear decision boundary based on a clinically significant threshold, which can help group similar individuals in the feature space.

features.name: glucose_level_indicator
features.description: Categorical indicator for plasma glucose levels based on common unsupervised thresholds: 0 for normal (<100), 1 for elevated (100-140), 2 for high (>140).
features.expected_model_benefit: Segments the data into distinct metabolic groups, potentially improving the local neighborhood definition for KNN.

features.name: insulin_resistance_proxy
features.description: A ratio of insulin to plasma glucose, serving as a proxy for insulin resistance. Higher values suggest more resistance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two correlated features into a single, more powerful metric that can improve distance calculations by capturing a key physiological state.

features.name: age_zscore
features.description: Age normalized using the training set's mean and standard deviation. This standardizes the scale of the age feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents the age feature from dominating distance calculations due to its scale, ensuring a more balanced contribution to neighborhood definitions.

features.name: pregnancies_per_decade
features.description: The number of pregnancies normalized by the person's age in decades. This creates a rate that is more comparable across different ages.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a scale-invariant feature that might better capture the intensity of pregnancy history than the raw count, improving similarity measures.

features.name: distance_to_mean_profile
features.description: The Euclidean distance of a person's standardized profile from the mean profile of the training set. A measure of how atypical an individual is.
features.expected_model_benefit: This is a powerful meta-feature for KNN, as it explicitly encodes a notion of distance (outlierness) from a central, unsupervised prototype.

features.name: blood_pressure_category
features.description: Categorizes diastolic blood pressure (pres) into three levels: 0 for normal (<80), 1 for elevated (80-89), and 2 for high (>=90).
features.expected_model_benefit: Discretizes a continuous variable into meaningful clinical groups, which can help form more coherent neighborhoods.

features.name: has_implausible_zero_value
features.description: Binary indicator that is 1 if any of the physiologically critical measures (glucose, blood pressure, skin thickness, or BMI) are zero, suggesting missing or invalid data.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the model isolate and treat potentially erroneous data points differently, preventing them from distorting the local neighborhood geometry.

features.name: metabolic_stress_score
features.description: A composite score calculated as the sum of the z-scores for plasma glucose, BMI, and insulin. Higher scores indicate greater metabolic stress.
features.expected_model_benefit: Projects several key indicators onto a single dimension, potentially creating a strong, linear separator that improves cluster definition.

features.name: pedigree_impact_level
features.description: A semantic grouping of the diabetes pedigree function value, representing genetic risk influence. 0 for low (pedi < 0.25), 1 for medium (0.25 <= pedi < 0.75), 2 for high (pedi >= 0.75).
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts a skewed continuous variable into a more stable, categorical feature that can improve neighborhood similarity for individuals with comparable genetic predispositions.

features.name: age_pregnancy_interaction_risk
features.description: A judgment-based risk score based on the interaction between age and number of pregnancies. 0: Low (e.g., age < 30 and preg < 3), 1: Medium, 2: High (e.g., age > 40 and preg > 5).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a non-linear interaction that simple distance metrics might miss, grouping individuals with similar life-stage and reproductive history profiles.

features.name: overall_health_profile_deviation
features.description: A semantic score indicating deviation from a generally accepted healthy profile (e.g., plas<100, mass<25, pres<80). 0: Close to healthy, 1: Moderate deviation, 2: Significant deviation across multiple factors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, non-linear summary of a person's health. This acts as a distance-like feature from an abstract 'healthy' prototype, which can be very effective for KNN.
